data.name: Ansari
data.gender_notes: Ansari is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ansari refers to the companions of the Prophet Muhammad who provided support and shelter to him and his followers during his exile in Medina. The name Ansari carries the meaning “Supporter of the Messenger” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ansari usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter of the messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who supports and upholds the truth
data.etymology: Ansari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter of the Messenger.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansari total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أنصاري
in_arabic.meaning: منافقين کے خلاف لڑنے والے، انصار، সাহায্যকারী
in_arabic.long_meaning: أنصاري تعني الشخص الذي ينصر ويساعد، وخاصة من الأنصار الذين ساعدوا النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم في المدينة المنورة، والأنصار هم أهل المدينة الذين آمنوا بالنبي محمد وصدقوه وساعدوه

in_urdu.name: انصاری
in_urdu.meaning: مددگار، حامی، منافقین کے مخالف، انصار
in_urdu.long_meaning: انصاری نام کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنے والا یا حامی، یہ نام انصار سے ماخوذ ہے جو مدینہ منورہ کے باشندے تھے جنہوں نے نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی مدد کی اور ان کا ساتھ دیا، انصاری نام ذاتی صفات جیسے وفاداری، حمایت اور تعاون کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अंसारी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अंसारी नाम का अर्थ है सहायक या मददगार, यह नाम इस्लामी इतिहास में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाने वाले अनसार से लिया गया है, जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद के साथी और समर्थक थे, अंसारी नाम समर्थन, सहयोग और वफादारी जैसे व्यक्तिगत गुणों को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: انصاري

in_english.name: Ansari
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ansari originates from the Arabic root 'N-S-R' which means 'to support' or 'to help', in Islamic history, the Ansar were the inhabitants of Medina who supported and helped the Prophet Muhammad, the name Ansari signifies a person who provides assistance, support, and aid to others, reflecting qualities of loyalty, friendship, and generosity

pronunciation.urdu: انصاری کا تلفظ ان سا ري ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ansari" holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic history as it represents a steadfast commitment to support and protect the Prophet Muhammad and his early Muslim community. These individuals, known as Ansar, welcomed the Prophet and his followers with open arms and offered them shelter, food, and protection during a time of great adversity. Their hospitality and courage in the face of persecution set an example for future generations of Muslims and reinforced the concepts of brotherhood, unity, and community that are central to the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ansari" is a source of inspiration and guidance, reminding us of the importance of providing support and care to those in need. It emphasizes the notion of serving and helping others, which is a foundation of Islamic teachings. Furthermore, the name carries the blessings and merits of the early Muslims who generously opened their doors and hearts to the Prophet Muhammad and his community. By embracing the spiritual significance of this name, we are encouraged to embody the qualities of kindness, generosity, and hospitality, striving to create a compassionate and harmonious community for all among us.
